verdict.rationale: Inside the product, the evidence shows only AI automation: AI reads bills and auto-fills payment details (docs-3), and AI-powered accounting automations help close the books (docs-6). Actual insights from the user's data, such as natural-language questions, transaction graphs, spend analysis and anomaly detection, come through the external MCP server and agent skills used in third-party AI tools (docs-32, docs-31, supp-agent-skills), not natively in the product. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI assistant or insights surface, AI-generated analytical insights or suggestions shown inside the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product AI features.
